utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Oren, are you coming to the repair drive? I've got spare tools if you need any.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! Right, I was just trying to remember... is it this Saturday or next? I keep mixing it up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: It's this Saturday, Oren! I've got my tools ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Bo, you've heard about the repair drive, right? I keep mixin' up the date, is it this weekend or the next?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I think it's this Saturday, but honestly I'm not totally sure—I've been so busy I just skimmed the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, I thought so too, but I wanted to double-check. Thanks, Bo!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: It's this Saturday, Oren. Same weekend we talked about last time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Count me in, Mina. I'll have my tools ready and that lawnmower too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Sam. Do you need any specific parts for that lawnmower, or can you fix it with what you've got?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually serious about this repair drive thing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely! This Saturday, we're fixing up the playground. You should come—it'll be fun!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, so it's this Saturday for sure? Not next weekend? I just want to be certain before I rearrange my plans.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll be there, but I might not be much help this time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Don't worry, Uli, any help is appreciated! Maybe you could handle the sign-in sheet or bring snacks?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I can do that. I'll bring some pretzels and lemonade.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Now that we've got the transport sorted, I say we finalize the donation list so nothing gets left behind.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh totally! I've already got a list going—Mrs. Gable is donating her old toaster and the Johnsons said they'd bring that broken lawnmower. Should be a good haul!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, good. Let's write it all down in order of pickup so we don't waste time zigzagging across the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's this Saturday. Maple Street in the morning, the warehouse after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Rey! I'll be at Maple Street in the morning. My school pickups are covered for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Alright, let's head to Maple Street first—I've got the directions ready.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I'll grab my tools and meet you at the truck.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, I'll be waiting by the truck. Let's make this quick.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, let's go with your truck and the bins, but I'll jot down a few neighbors' numbers just in case.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, so we're using my truck and bins for the repair drive Saturday 10-4 at the community center. Let's make sure everyone knows!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Right, and I'll send out a quick reminder Thursday so folks have time to prep their donations before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Cleo, before we dive into the lists, I need to let you know we've rescheduled the repair drive to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, good thing you told me—I already had Saturday blocked off. I'll update my calendar and bring those spare parts over Sunday morning.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo! That's a huge relief—having your spare parts will really help us out.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, hi Noah! Yes, the repair drive is this Saturday. I'm just double-checking that we have all the tools in good shape—some of the donations need a little TLC before we can use them.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive! Saturday—got it. So, uh, what tools are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Well, we've got a mix—a few hammers, some screwdrivers, and even an old drill. I'm mostly worried about the rusted saw blades and a wobbly wrench.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Leo, you going to be around for the repair drive this weekend? I'm helping Rosa pass out flyers.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I'll be there. Need me to handle anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, maybe you can take the south side of the block—Rosa said we need more coverage over there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Oren, I was just talking to Hana about the repair drive—she could use some help sorting through donations. Want to lend a hand?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I'd love to help, but I'm still fuzzy on when it is—was it this Saturday or next? I'll dig through my pockets for that note.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It's this Saturday, Oren—Hana mentioned it starts at 10 a.m. in the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Kira, have you heard when the repair drive is finally coming to our block? I've been waiting to get that leaky faucet looked at.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're actually serious about this repair drive thing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely serious! That leak's been driving me crazy for weeks now.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's great, Eli. But do you know the weight capacity of your truck? We need to make sure we don't overload it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help weigh the parts on my bathroom scale if that helps us figure out the load.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Cleo, that's a smart idea, but are you sure a bathroom scale can handle heavy tools and materials? I'm just worried we might break it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, Bo! The repair drive is this Saturday at 10 AM. We're meeting at the community center first, then splitting up to the three main spots: Elm Street, Oak Avenue, and Maple Lane. Need directions?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Saturday at 10, got it. Just point me to one of those spots, I'll handle whatever needs fixin' there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure thing, Bo! Why don't you head to Elm Street? It's just two blocks east of the community center, the one with the big oak tree out front.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, Leo! It's this Saturday from 10 AM to 4 PM at the community center—bring anything broken and we'll fix it together!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good to know. I'll bring my toolkit and be there by 9.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Eli, you're gonna want to join us for the repair drive this Saturday—we're sprucing up the playground and could use your energy!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, Quinn, you know I like a plan. What time Saturday and what's the exact setup we're working with?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We're kicking off at 9 AM sharp, Eli! Got the tools lined up, just need hands to sand and paint the swings and benches.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Hana, are you still free to help with the repair drive on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'm still free on Saturday, but could you remind me what exactly needs fixing? I want to make sure I'm prepared.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure! There's a few broken chairs, a wonky bookshelf, and a lamp that needs rewiring. Bring your toolbox if you have one!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what's the plan for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, what repair drive? I think I missed something—could you fill me in?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: You didn't hear? The whole neighborhood's getting together to fix up the community center this weekend. I thought you were on the list.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Tess, sorry I'm late—did I miss anything important?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you just missed Faye asking about the repair drive this weekend. She's worried about school pickup times clashing. Are you still in for helping out?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'm still in. Just let me know what time we're starting and I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Rosa, I'm glad you're here! I've already asked Sam to bring his lawnmower, and Uli will be there early to help set up. Want to lend a hand with sign-ins or just bring something to fix?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful, Mara! With Sam's lawnmower and Uli's early help, we're really coming together. I'd love to handle sign-ins—it'll be a great way to greet everyone and make sure things run smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect, Rosa! Sign-ins are a big help—I'll make sure you have a list of volunteers and a welcome table ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, I've got my tool shed all organized and ready for the repair drive—what can I bring along?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh that's great, Gus! So it is happening for sure? I keep hearing different dates, do you know when exactly we're starting?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, it's this Saturday for sure, starting at 9 AM. I've got my tools ready—just tell me what you need.
